# Runnable in-build binaries do not require GIR generation, which is disabled
# for sanitizer builds and some cross-builds with an executable wrapper.
if meson.can_run_host_binaries()
  if enable_console_bin
    gimp_real_exe = gimpconsole_exe
  else
    gimp_real_exe = gimpmain_exe
  endif
  gimp_exe_depends = [gimp_real_exe] + plugin_custom_targets
  if have_gobject_introspection
    gimp_exe_depends += [libgimp_gir, libgimpui_gir]
  endif

if have_gobject_introspection
      gimp_exe_depends += [patched_libgimp_gir, patched_libgimpui_gir]

      gimp_run_env.set('GIMP_GI_DIR', gi.get_variable('libdir'))
    endif
